_caveat: reported_size_bytes is the RAW SUM of imageDetails[].imageSizeInBytes across every image in the repo. ECR does not deduplicate shared layers in this figure — an image's reported size includes every layer it references even when that layer's blob is physically stored once and shared with other images/repos. This number is directionally useful (shows the repo is non-trivial, not empty) but is NOT the actual billed/dedup'd byte count; the Cost Explorer figures in SPIKE.md are the ground truth for billed storage.
